lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition K4Pb4Br16 (reduced formula KPbBr4) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Pb and K centers each surrounded by eight Br neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while each Br center has ten geometric neighbors (two K, two Pb, and six Br). Corner- and face-sharing is observed between the 10-vertex Br polyhedra and the 8-vertex K and Pb polyhedra, and between Br polyhedra themselves. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
